name: Tombstone Slaughter: El Gordo's Revenge

features.name: Special sixth reel
features.description: Only revolvers and characters land there.

review:
Famous for its 500,000x cap – the highest Nolimit has published. The 2-3-3-3-3-2 grid has a special sixth reel that only holds two-high revolvers and character symbols, and stacked xNudge wilds gain +1 per nudge.

Slaughter Scatters land on the middle four reels. Insane volatility and a 9% hit rate – nine spins in ten pay nothing. Enjoy it in demo for the spectacle.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
